title: Lesson
description: Structured lesson extracted from review findings, retries, and failures. Feeds the learning loop.

pattern.description: The recurring pattern observed (e.g., 'missing rate limiting on public endpoints')

preventive_rule.description: Concrete rule to prevent recurrence (e.g., 'every new public endpoint must include rate limit in acceptance criteria')

confidence.description: How confident are we this rule is correct

times_seen.description: How many times this pattern was observed

superseded_by.description: If this lesson was replaced by a better one, reference its id
